reasons: The file contains only a description, so there is nothing to test or judge.

terms.meaning: a folder of Python files that can be imported together

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Package description
sections.what: Gives the SharePoint folder a one-line description. It does not run any code.
sections.why: Python needs a file like this to treat the folder as a package.

summary: Marks the sharepoint folder as a Python package and describes it; it has no behaviour of its own.
purpose: Gives the SharePoint code folder a name and a one-line description.
why: Python needs a file like this to treat the folder as a package that other files can import from.
how: Python reads the file when another file imports from this folder. It runs nothing beyond the description string.
debug: If imports from this folder fail, check that the file exists and that the folder name matches the import path.
